content.text: Meat (red), liver, beans/lentils, fortified cereal, Spinach
- Plant & animal: liver, kidney, yeast, leafy green veggies
- Absorbed in duodenum      -  Heme Fe ↑absorb > non-heme
-Unalt form = prox jejunum readily & completely absorb
- Stored as ferritin/hemosiderin in liver, spleen, marrow
- Chronic blood loss (e.g., menstruation, GI bleed)
- acid suppression     - Long-term tx w metformin    - Old
-Gastric bypass pt     - certain autoimmune dx          - Vegans
- Loss or malfunction of absorptive mech in ileum
parietal cells -> loss of IF or lack of IF
- diet: poss yrs for Sx b/c stores
- Drugs: chemotx folate reductase- i (methotrexate, trimethoprim, pyrimethamine), phenytoin, rifampin, barbiturates, ethanol, sulfasalazine or other chronic sulfonamide
- IV iron if severe or malabsorption
- If malabsorb → IM or intranasal B12
(malabsorb Dx, small bowel dz, gastric/ileal resections)
